text: S526 found the current CLO Trial License clause defines Trial Purposes as evaluation/demo but excludes commercial and for-profit purposes. Individual paid licensing may allow qualifying one-person commercial use; that does not erase the trial restriction. General Terms allow automatic Internet connections/remote authentication, and Work Product Content Analytics is licensed; privacy terms do not prove local-only handling. Do not run new CLO pattern tests until appropriate written rights and local-handling authority exist. Keep every V03 acceptance criterion unchanged; CLO remains open and untouched.
